metadata.name: WARIBA Design Tokens
metadata.aliasFormatDescription: Token aliases use a single path enclosed in curly braces.

300.$description: Coral for text. 400 is the sell identity and the down-candle, where the colour is a fill and the contrast that matters is white on top of it. As a foreground it measures 4.00:1 on its own sell wash, under the 4.5:1 AA floor, so negative *text* takes this lighter step instead. Same hex as the Hub's --wariba-accent-red, so the product has one red for a losing number rather than two that drift.

flashPositive.$description: Lowered from 0.28. The value-roll tint is a transient that says "this moved", but at 0.28 it darkened the metric tile enough to drop every foreground below AA while showing — the negative figure to 2.96:1, its own label to 4.22:1, even the positive green to 4.05:1. 0.18 is the measured point where the worst pairing clears 4.5:1, and it stays visibly stronger than the 0.16 resting wash.

validationRules: all color values must be valid CSS colors
all dimensions must include units except zero
all component radii must be less than or equal to 20px except radius.full
critical mobile touch targets must be at least 44px
semantic colors must not be the sole carrier of meaning
